cinematics.title: Pilaf's Accidental Wish
cinematics.script_event: Pilaf summons Black Smoke Shenron; Goku is turned into Kid Goku.

cinematics.title: Space Launching from Capsule Corp
cinematics.script_event: Pan sneaks onto the spaceship with Kid Goku and Trunks.

cinematics.title: Return to an Infected Earth
cinematics.script_event: Baby Vegeta reveals he possessed Gohan, Goten, and Vegeta.

cinematics.title: SSJ4 Awakening on Planet Plant
cinematics.script_event: Pan's tears awaken Goku from Golden Oozaru into Super Saiyan 4.

cinematics.title: The Android 17 Hell Fusion
cinematics.script_event: Goku SSJ4 and Android 18 perform Dragon Fist (0x1A).

cinematics.title: The Cracked Dragon Balls
cinematics.script_event: Black Smoke Shenron releases the 7 Shadow Dragons.

cinematics.title: Omega Shenron Climax & Gogeta SSJ4 Fusion
cinematics.script_event: Goku SSJ4 and Vegeta SSJ4 fuse into Gogeta SSJ4 and fire Big Bang Kamehameha x100.

cinematics.title: Universal Spirit Bomb Epilogue
cinematics.script_event: Goku bids farewell to Earth, opening the path to AF (Zaiko) and Divine (Beerus/Whis) Postgame chapters.
